status_of_this_entry: Our copy of the paper's Methods sentence on distance correction was lost: the browser report that copied Table S1 was cut off before that part. We have NOT confirmed that the paper is silent on it. Under the pre-registered plan (findings/2026-11-22-prereg30-pkp-position-plan.md), anything other than an explicit statement of 'none' or 'catalogue-1D' counts as not-stated, so both readings (R and C) are the headline, written R:<grade> / C:<grade>. If the sentence is found later, it will be quoted in the results note as report-only context; the headline will not be changed to one reading after the grades are known.
coordinate_source_per_table_s1_caption: Hypocenter parameters before 1990 are from Marshall et al. (1993); after 1990 from the ISC Bulletin (Table S1 caption, as copied). The plan's text names the CMR/Yang et al. (2002) database; that was our error before we read the caption. The code does not depend on it.
table_s1_note: Stars in the date column mark the 18 tests that formed Zhou's 112 pairs (differential epicentral distance < 0.05 deg). The 5 unstarred tests were used only in the closest-pair (< 2 km) analysis. The table is transcribed verbatim with the stars kept.
